prayers.name: Ghurish Beat
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of the target terrain feature. If the chanting roll was 9+, you can pick 2 eligible terrain features to be the targets instead of 1.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironsunz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Ironsunz Beat
prayers.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit whose Health characteristic is lower than the target's.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit whose Health characteristic is the same as or greater than the target's.
If the chanting roll was 10+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons instead.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironsunz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Krumpin' Beat
prayers.effect: Inflict D3 damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, inflict D3 damage on each enemy unit within 3" of the target.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironsunz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
